email.body1:
Jeremy, saw Coherent's Insurity and Novidea partnerships to modernize insurance product management and migrate P&C insurers off legacy.

New alliances like that usually open more in-market insurer accounts than the team can cover before they cool, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Coherent off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jeremy, quick follow-up for Coherent.

With new partner channels feeding leads, the pipeline target climbs faster than reps can ramp. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Coherent needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jeremy, last bit of proof for Coherent.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Coherent's reply rate likely compares to other insurtech vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jeremy, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters most as new partnerships ramp, and I know running a multi-partner GTM motion is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an insurtech motion? I will tailor it to Coherent either way.
